description: Check whether a person was born with the Moon in a Gand Mool nakshatra (Ashwini, Ashlesha, Magha, Jyeshtha, Mula or Revati), with the pada and whether it falls on the sign junction (gandanta). Birth time is optional; without it the result says if the Moon changed nakshatra that day.

language.description: Set to "hi" to add Hindi (Devanagari) names next to the English ones, for answering in Hindi.

name: check_gand_mool
title: Gand Mool nakshatra check
